what: a file tool pointed at a viking:// URI is denied, naming the mcp_call to use

hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecisionReason:
viking:// URIs are OpenViking virtual paths, not local filesystem paths.
Use OpenViking MCP read instead.
Example: mcp_call(toolName="mcp__openviking__read", arguments={uri="viking://user/me/memories/x.md"})
